files.detail: 保护内容初检通过；仍需语义审校

pairs.source: 团队负责人可以创建目标，团队成员只能更新自己负责的关键结果。
pairs.translation: A team lead can create an objective. A team member can only update a key result assigned to them.

pairs.source: 打开目标详情，选择需要更新的关键结果。
pairs.translation: Open the objective details and select the key result to update.

pairs.source: 填写进展说明后保存；进度更新不需要负责人审核。
pairs.translation: Enter a progress note and save. Progress updates do not require approval from the team lead.

pairs.source: 完成率低于 60% 时提醒负责人
pairs.translation: Notify the team lead when completion falls below 60%

pairs.source: 删除目标后不能恢复，请先确认。
pairs.translation: A deleted objective cannot be restored. Please confirm before deleting it.

pairs.source: 查看 [帮助中心](https://example.org/help)。接口字段 `goal_id` 和变量 {member_name} 必须保留。
pairs.translation: See the [Help Center](https://example.org/help). The API field `goal_id` and the variable {member_name} must remain unchanged.
